inputs.checklistItemText: Adjacent driveways within 300 feet not shown on plans (DRV-04)
inputs.question: Are adjacent driveways on neighboring properties shown on this sheet? Look for driveways on properties adjacent to the subject site, particularly along South Lamar Boulevard. Adjacent driveways would appear as wide, flat-bottomed U-shapes or J-shapes opening toward the street on adjacent parcels.
inputs.regionHint: along South Lamar Boulevard on adjacent properties to the north and south

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-identification question—whether adjacent driveways appear on the sheet at all—rather than measuring the 300-foot spacing between them. This is a progressive verification step (presence check before measurement); the actual DRV-04 compliance (spacing dimension) would require measurement, but the agent is currently doing sheet-discovery and feature-presence inspection.
